input.content: Pattern (P1, compatibility): Client increment strictly requires a new response field (e.g. `response.get("applied") is not True` -> raise) that only a pending/unreleased provider will emit, while the client must ship independently against a released provider baseline. The old provider applies the change and returns success without the field, so every call reports false failure after side effects already happened; retries repeat the failure. Feature flags (e.g. enhanced_settings) did not gate the new check. Companion smell: the test mock was edited to return the new field, so no test covers the released provider's response shape and the suite stays green. Review action: compare against the named release-tag provider source (git show <tag>:<path>), require a tolerant read (fail only on explicit negative receipt) or flag-gating until the supported baseline advances, and keep a test that mimics the released provider response.
